requirement.fact: {data_dave} suggested keeping the data ingestion pipeline manual to allow for verification steps.
requirement.reading: He would accept a lower level of automation if it allows for manual quality checks.

speaker.name: Data Dave
speaker.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.objection: You are treating my request for manual verification as a simple preference, but it is a non negotiable safeguard for data quality. I will not sign off on automated ingestion until we have a documented process for catching bad scan lines before they poison the forecast.
output.correction: Stop calling this a trade off in automation levels, because I am not asking to slow down the pipeline for the sake of bureaucracy. I am asking for a governed checkpoint where humans can inspect the data, and that is a different kind of control than just running the job faster.
